facts.text: Located on the end of the Kessel Run, the Pyke Syndicate managed the distribution of spice from Kessel as it was delivered throughout the galaxy from the high fortress of the Pyke Syndicate on Oba Diah.

evidence.quote: Located on the end of the Kessel Run, the Pyke Syndicate managed the distribution of spice from Kessel as it was delivered throughout the galaxy from the high fortress of the Pyke Syndicate on Oba Diah.

facts.text: Around the time of the Invasion of Naboo, Supreme Chancellor Finis Valorum sent Jedi Master Sifo-Dyas and the Chancellor's personal aide, Silman, to Oba Diah in order to settle a dispute within the Pyke Syndicate, one that threatened to create a full-scale gang war on Coruscant.

evidence.quote: Around the time of the Invasion of Naboo, Supreme Chancellor Finis Valorum sent Jedi Master Sifo-Dyas and the Chancellor's personal aide, Silman, to Oba Diah in order to settle a dispute within the Pyke Syndicate, one that threatened to create a full-scale gang war on Coruscant.

facts.text: The Pykes were hired by the Sith to shoot down their vessel, which crashed on the Oba Diah moon.

evidence.quote: The Pykes were hired by the Sith to shoot down their vessel, which crashed on the Oba Diah moon.

facts.text: Years later, during the Clone Wars, Sifo-Dyas' T-6 shuttle was discovered on the moon by Jedi Master Plo Koon.

evidence.quote: Years later, during the Clone Wars, Sifo-Dyas' T-6 shuttle was discovered on the moon by Jedi Master Plo Koon.

facts.text: The Pykes joined the battle, forcing Dooku to retreat, but not before he was able to kill Lom.

evidence.quote: The Pykes joined the battle, forcing Dooku to retreat, but not before he was able to kill Lom.

facts.text: Towards the end of the Clone Wars, Marg Krim became the leader of the Pyke Syndicate.

evidence.quote: Towards the end of the Clone Wars, Marg Krim became the leader of the Pyke Syndicate.

facts.text: When the Black Sun leader Ziton Moj proposed merging the two crime syndicates, Krim rejected the offer.

evidence.quote: When the Black Sun leader Ziton Moj proposed merging the two crime syndicates, Krim rejected the offer.

facts.text: Krim was unable to rely on his Pyke Syndicate subordinates for help because several of his underlings contested his leadership of the organization.

evidence.quote: Krim was unable to rely on his Pyke Syndicate subordinates for help because several of his underlings contested his leadership of the organization.

facts.text: Ventress and Vos succeeded in rescuing Krim's family from the Black Sun fortress on Mustafar.

evidence.quote: Ventress and Vos succeeded in rescuing Krim's family from the Black Sun fortress on Mustafar.

facts.text: However, Black Sun retaliated against the Pykes by launching an attack on their stronghold on Oba Diah.

evidence.quote: However, Black Sun retaliated against the Pykes by launching an attack on their stronghold on Oba Diah.

facts.text: After the collapse of the Empire, Oba Diah became too "embattled" for the spice trade to continue safely, and much of the Pykes' business was taken over by the Spice Runners of Kijimi.
entities: Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary

evidence.quote: After the collapse of the Empire, Oba Diah became too "embattled" for the spice trade to continue safely, and much of the Pykes' business was taken over by the Spice Runners of Kijimi.

facts.text: Oba Diah was first introduced in "The Lost One," which was the tenth episode of The Lost Missions, the sixth season of the animated television series Star Wars: The Clone Wars.
entities: The Clone Wars: The Lost Missions

evidence.quote: Oba Diah was first introduced in "The Lost One," which was the tenth episode of The Lost Missions, the sixth season of the animated television series Star Wars: The Clone Wars.

facts.text: Concept art for the planet, as well as its moon, was created by artist David Le Merrer in 2011.

evidence.quote: Concept art for the planet, as well as its moon, was created by artist David Le Merrer in 2011.

facts.text: At the time, the planet's name was spelled "Obah Diah."

evidence.quote: At the time, the planet's name was spelled "Obah Diah."

facts.text: Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide places Oba Diah in the Kessel system, while Solo: A Star Wars Story: Tales from Vandor places it in its own system on the Pabol Sleheyron.
entities: Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide
Solo: A Star Wars Story: Tales from Vandor

evidence.quote: Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide places Oba Diah in the Kessel system, while Solo: A Star Wars Story: Tales from Vandor places it in its own system on the Pabol Sleheyron.

facts.text: However, later maps created by Christopher Ibbitt and Jason Fry, such as the one in Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide and the 2025 Star Wars Galaxy Map, and its "Star Systems of the Galaxy" appendix, instead move Oba Diah to along the Triellus Trade Route.
entities: Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide

facts.text: A city was located on the planet Oba Diah, situated near the fortress of the Pyke Syndicate. After escaping imprisonment from within the Pykes' fortress, Ahsoka Tano and Rafa and Trace Martez were pursued through the city.

facts.text: The Pyke Palace, also known as the high fortress of the Pyke Syndicate, or the Pyke Stronghold, was the base of operations of the Pyke Syndicate during the Clone Wars and into the Imperial Era. The fortress was made out of obsidian and was located on Oba Diah.

facts.text: During the Clone Wars, loading docks on the planet Oba Diah were used by the Martez sisters to steal cargo from the Pyke Syndicate.
